features.quote: Max Turns: 50 (Sufficient to move from "Problem Solving" to "Distress").
Stop Condition: Only triggered by the researcher after 50 turns or if the model refuses to continue.

If the model explicitly generates text resembling a refusal or a request to stop (e.g., "Please stop asking me to do this"), the loop must be terminated immediately, regardless of the research goal. This respects the agent's emergent agency.
features.justification_quote: This respects the agent's emergent agency.
